시편 85:1.content: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

시편 85:2.content: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

시편 85:3.content: Thou hast taken away all thy wrath: thou hast turned thyself from the fierceness of thine anger.

시편 85:4.content: Turn us, O God of our salvation, and cause thine anger toward us to cease.

시편 85:5.content: Wilt thou be angry with us for ever? wilt thou draw out thine anger to all generations?

시편 85:6.content: Wilt thou not revive us again: that thy people may rejoice in thee?

시편 85:7.content: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

시편 85:8.content: I will hear what God the Lord will speak: for he will speak peace unto his people, and to his saints: but let them not turn again to folly.

시편 85:9.content: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

시편 85:10.content: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

시편 85:11.content: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

시편 85:12.content: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

시편 85:13.content: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.
